plainTranslation: Someone's planet or rising sign hitting your Vertex - a sensitive point tied to charged, out-of-nowhere meetings - makes the encounter feel unusually charged. Strong pull, fast. Common in romantic charts. Feels charged, which is a feeling, not a contract.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
